purpose: Multipart admin asset upload metadata contract.
ownedRules: Upload metadata may bind an original image to categoryFamilyKey, categoryProductTypeKey, productSku, altText, tags, and SEO fields.
Tags are normalized through AssetTagRules during record construction before repository persistence.
Upload tags must follow the media_assets.tags contract: uppercase token values, 40 characters per tag, 16 tags maximum.
